quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: *sob* Freed I am at last! Freed from this Saurian cart!

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Ugh. That cart was so stuffy and hot... and stinky, too! I sat in it for half a day, and I already feel like it shaved two or three years off my lifespan...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You again? Really? What happened this time?

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you, my savior! I did not expect to run into— I mean, have you rescue me again during our respective travels...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Ah, did I not say previously that my name is Conulaf, a trainee priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind?

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: My training's a work in progress at the moment, and to that end, the elders of the tribe told me that there are ancestral treasures to be found all over Natlan. "Go do some treasure-hunting, Conulaf!" they said.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: And so they kicked me out of the tribe under the guise of training—

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: And well, my keen ears picked up some clues about treasure to be found nearby... Something about finding it if I followed the footsteps of some beast.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: But doesn't that refer to a Sumpter Beast, I thought? Or could it be an Alpaca instead?

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Either way, I followed a Sumpter Beast to the camp these folks had made, and thinking I was some manner of Sumpter Beast thief, they locked me up...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Forget the buried treasure, I was about to be buried myself...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You had an incomplete trail of clues to begin with...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Right you are! I shan't act quite so rashly going forward... Hmm. Perhaps that lesson is the greatest treasure I could have obtained from this incident.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'll have to find a place to take a nice shower to get this smell off me.

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, my savior! Allow me to give you a humble token, drawn from my limited traveling expenses, to show my gratitude...
